text: What is the primary concept of social responsibility in business?
options: Maximizing profits
Minimizing costs
Meeting legal requirements
Giving back to the community
correctAnswer: Giving back to the community
explanation: According to the NCERT textbook, social responsibility refers to the obligations of business to pursue long-term goals that benefit not only themselves but also the community and society at large.
